scenario.description: two very severe storm events; own-funds reduction equivalent to present-day impacts of Bernd 2021 and Kyrill 2007

scientific_limits: SCR increase and change in eligible own funds are not direct insured event losses or gross/net catastrophe loss amounts.
Events have no public full footprints, event loss vectors, precise insurance exposure, policy/reinsurance conditions or calibrated annual frequencies here.
The public hypothetical stress is not a 1-in-200 or 99.5 percent event loss and cannot be directly mapped onto OEP/AEP curves.
The 2025 solo stress must not be equated with 2025 group elemental claims EUR 150m or 2024 group elemental claims EUR 442m.
May be used as a future independently held-out aggregate resilience/sensitivity challenge only if capital, tax, own-funds and risk mitigation semantics are comparable.
